newsitem.title: USA: LSI Industries to Acquire Grady McCauley.
newsitem.headline: LSI Industries to Acquire Grady McCauley.

text.p: LSI Industries Inc said Monday it has entered into a letter of intent to purchase substantially all of the assets and the business of Grady McCauley Inc for $6 million in cash, 475,700 common shares of LSI and the assumption of certain liabilities.

LSI will also be purchasing the new facility used by Grady McCauley which is owned by a related company, Gramac Enterprises, Ltd. The transaction is expected to be completed during June 1997, and is subject to, among other things, completion of due diligence and execution of a definitive asset purchase agreement.
